name: Lumivéu
summary: Lumivéu is an interactive, community-driven game tailor-made for Twitch, where viewers step away from being passive spectators to become an active part of the world. Fully integrated into the live chat, the game allows the audience to explore mystical regions, gather valuable resources, upgrade gear, and participate in strategic duels in real-time while watching the stream. The game's ecosystem expands beyond the stream through its own dedicated website featuring a proprietary economy system, allowing players to manage inventories, track the marketplace, and persistently progress their characters. With engaging RPG mechanics and a focus on social engagement, Lumivéu transforms the live stream into a living board game.
